title: Wolf Queen and Fallen Witch
description: A pale, emaciated witch-like woman with long flowing purple hair and a flower crown kneels on a blood-stained wooden pier, reaching toward floating bubbles and scattered tarot cards. Behind her looms a giant spectral purple wolf wearing a crown, set against a burning orange sunset over a flooded city skyline with a highway running through the water.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene at sunset showing a pale skeletal witch with long purple hair and flower crown kneeling on a flooded wooden pier covered in blood and scattered tarot cards. A giant spectral purple wolf with glowing eyes and a crown stands behind her. A highway runs through the water toward a burning city skyline. Floating bubbles and a heart-shaped smoke trail fill the air, dramatic orange and purple color palette, dark fantasy style.
